name: Norske naturreservater
title: Norske naturreservater
description: Norske naturreservater (nature reserves in Norway, naturreservat) — comprehensive list of legally protected areas under the Norwegian Nature Diversity Act (naturmangfoldloven §37), covering nature reserves across all 16 fylker (counties) including Svalbard, Bouvetøya and Jan Mayen. Each record includes Wikidata QID, names in Norwegian Bokmål / Nynorsk / English / Swedish / Danish / German, instance-of types, admin location (kommune/fylke), country, terrain features, IUCN protected area category, coordinates (WGS84), area in hectares (unit-normalized), inception year, Wikimedia Commons image URL, and Wikipedia sitelinks for nowiki/nnwiki/enwiki/svwiki/dawiki/dewiki/frwiki/nlwiki/fiwiki.

meta.description: Norske naturreservater (nature reserves in Norway, naturreservat) — comprehensive list of legally protected areas under the Norwegian Nature Diversity Act (naturmangfoldloven §37), covering nature reserves across all 16 fylker (counties) including Svalbard, Bouvetøya and Jan Mayen. Each record includes Wikidata QID, names in Norwegian Bokmål / Nynorsk / English / Swedish / Danish / German, instance-of types, admin location (kommune/fylke), country, terrain features, IUCN protected area category, coordinates (WGS84), area in hectares (unit-normalized), inception year, Wikimedia Commons image URL, and Wikipedia sitelinks for nowiki/nnwiki/enwiki/svwiki/dawiki/dewiki/frwiki/nlwiki/fiwiki. Inneholder 1748 poster. Last ned i Excel, CSV, PDF format.
